h1: 2street Hostel Surat Thani — a small owner-run hostel a short walk from the night market
intro: If you're after a budget stay in central Surat Thani for a night before crossing to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao, 2street Hostel is one of the names backpackers keep passing on to each other · It's a small adults-only hostel on Bandon Road, just a 4-minute walk from the night market · It isn't fancy, but it's clean, the beds are genuinely comfortable, and it has an owner who looks after guests personally — enough that people remember her by name · Beds start at around ฿350/night — and real guest reviews agree it punches well above its price in this town

body.html: 2street Hostel is a small hostel in central Surat Thani, on Bandon Road in the Talat sub-district · What sets it apart from the average hostel is that the owner looks after guests herself — a name, "Su", comes up again and again in real reviews, and many guests say it feels more like staying at a friend's place than checking into accommodation · It's an adults-only property with a calm vibe, which suits solo travellers and couples on a budget.

Rooms come as beds in mixed dorms (6-bed and 8-bed) or as private rooms with A/C, an en-suite bathroom and a walk-in shower · The thing guests praise most consistently is the bed — one review goes as far as calling it "the comfiest bed I've slept in in Thailand," with mattresses thicker and softer than you'd expect at this price · Rooms are clean (cleanliness scores sit around 8.8), the Wi-Fi is fast, and there are lockers and luggage storage.
"Comfiest bed I've stayed in in Thailand, and the owner is so welcoming it feels like home — for the price, it's a 10 out of 10."

Location is the main selling point here · It's about a 4-minute walk to the Surat Thani night market, which is packed with food stalls · It sits close to Bandon Pier and the onward transport to Don Sak Pier, making it handy for anyone heading over to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao · There's a desk that helps book tours and ferry tickets, and — rare at this price — a free airport shuttle · The location score in reviews is around 9.6, which is very high.

The overall feel is friendly and quieter than a party hostel · It suits people who actually want to rest rather than chase a scene · The owner and staff are good at recommending local restaurants and sorting out island routes (staff scores sit around 9.7) · Breakfast comes in several styles — Western, Asian and vegetarian options — and reviews speak well of it.

To be straight with you, going by real reviews: 2street Hostel has the trade-offs you'd expect from a hostel · Some guests note that certain rooms are fairly dark and small, with limited space · And there's an unusual rule you won't find in many places: the air-conditioning takes a break roughly from noon to 3pm (12:00–15:00) every day — right in the hottest part of the afternoon, which can be uncomfortable if you're in the room then · The atmosphere score (around 7.9) sits below the others, which reflects that this place leans on cleanliness and care rather than flashy design or common spaces.

In short, if you want a budget stay in central Surat Thani that's clean, with a good bed, within walking distance of the night market, and run by an owner who genuinely cares — 2street Hostel is one of the best options in town · An overall score of around 8.9 from real reviews captures it well: "small but good, great value, lovely owner" · It works brilliantly as a one-night stop before crossing to the islands, or for budget travellers who aren't fussed about polish.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you want privacy and would rather avoid the afternoon A/C break, book a private room instead of a dorm bed and plan to be out exploring or at the market in the afternoon · Send your arrival time ahead to arrange the free airport shuttle, and if you're island-hopping, let the owner sort your ferry tickets and transfer to the pier all in one go.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — 2street Hostel Surat Thani

faq.q: Where is 2street Hostel in Surat Thani, and what's nearby?
faq.a: 2street Hostel is at 61 Bandon Road, Talat sub-district, in central Surat Thani · It's about a 4-minute walk to the night market · It's close to Bandon Pier and the onward transport to Don Sak Pier for the ferries to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Koh Tao · Surat Thani Airport is around 25 minutes by car, and there's a free airport shuttle.

faq.q: How much does 2street Hostel cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿350/night for a bed in an 8-bed mixed dorm · A 6-bed dorm runs about ฿390, and private rooms (with A/C and an en-suite bathroom) start around ฿750 · Prices vary by date and platform, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before you book.

faq.q: Does 2street Hostel accept children, and who is it best for?
faq.a: It's adults only and does not accept children · It's a great fit for solo travellers, couples and budget backpackers who want a clean stay with a good bed, close to the market and the ferries · Families with children should choose a town hotel with family rooms instead.

faq.q: What's the deal with the afternoon A/C break at 2street Hostel?
faq.a: There's an unusual rule here: the air-conditioning takes a break roughly from 12:00 to 15:00 every day · That's the hottest part of the afternoon, so it can be uncomfortable if you're in the room then · Plan to be out at the market or sightseeing in the afternoon, or pick a stay with all-day A/C if you can't handle the heat.

faq.q: Is 2street Hostel convenient for the island ferries?
faq.a: Very · The hostel is central and close to Bandon Pier, and the owner can book your ferry tickets and transfer to Don Sak Pier (about an hour by car) for the crossing to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao · That convenience is the main reason many travellers stay here for a night before island-hopping.

faq.q: Is 2street Hostel clean, and how are the beds?
faq.a: Real reviews rate cleanliness high, around 8.8, and praise the beds as thick and comfortable — many say the best they've slept in in Thailand · The Wi-Fi is fast, and there are lockers and luggage storage · The trade-offs: some rooms are small and dark, and the atmosphere score is a touch lower, because the focus here is cleanliness and care rather than design.
